test_classes.CURRENT_SYSTEM_EXECUTION_REACHABLE: All canonical runner, online Agent, SimplePIR, routing, BHTTP/OHTTP, Relay/Gateway, scheduler, effect recovery, DeliveryLedger, framework adapter, projection, and V12 confirmatory-harness tests; every node executes on Linux and must pass.
test_classes.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AUDIT: Tests of immutable V1-V11 artifacts or old host result trees outside the V12 selected runtime; provenance is audited without converting absent Linux result trees into current-system outcomes.
test_classes.PLATFORM_SPECIFIC_PORTABILITY: Tests tied to Windows-only historical layouts or Windows execution characteristics; retained as portability evidence and never promoted to Linux PASS.
